description: An introduction to the basic concepts and techniques of Artificial Intelligence. The main successes and challenges throughout history are covered. Topics include heuristics, searching, rule based programming (in Lisp and/or Prolog), knowledge representation in standard and nonstandard logics, neural networks and feature spaces. Applications to game playing, natural language processing, and recognition/classification.

title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
